basic_profile.bio: Hey, I'm a 19-year-old guy from Dallas, Texas, exploring my interests and identity. I'm currently taking a gap year before heading to college, where I plan to study graphic design. I'm passionate about art, digital design, and gaming. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new places around the city, especially local art galleries and cafes. I'm single and enjoying the freedom to meet new people. I'm usually online during late evenings as I juggle a part-time job at a local coffee shop.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in graphic design, thanks to online courses and tutorials. I started learning design tools during high school and have continued to hone my skills through personal projects and freelance gigs. I also have a keen interest in gaming, which I explore through discussions and community engagement.
